title: FLAVOR STATUS
content: PTGA-142 (10% alc) was evaluated at two different levels, 1% and .5%. The flavor was evaluated on substrate containing 7.5% CAG, 8% GPA and 20% B3. In both instances PTGA-142 was perceived as improving the smoke taste of alpha although a pronounced offtaste was detected. Recommendation: Reduce the level of (A-1) fraction present on PTGA-142
process: Precursor Mix #59 has been applied to the fiber glass and will be evaluated next week.
note: Various solid natural extracts are being evaluated on the substrate, some of these extracts are: Gentian root, valerian root, Juniper Berry and Guarana seed.
results: Evaluation results will be available next week.
